patch_description: Merge the pre- and post-entanglement RZ rotations into a single shared parameter "rz_shared". This reduces the total unique parameters from 3 (ry_shared, rz_pre, rz_post) to 2 (ry_shared, rz_shared), improving parameter efficiency from 0.05 to 0.07 and reducing n_params from 20 to 14. The second program demonstrates this achieves a higher combined score (0.72 vs 0.68) while maintaining perfect accuracy and generalization, making it more parameter-efficient for the small training set.
